item.title: Kane passes Modano for most points by US-born NHL player in Red Wings' 4-3 shootout loss to Capitals
item.description: Patrick Kane became the highest-scoring United States-born player in NHL history in the Detroit Red Wings' 4-3 loss to the Washington Capitals, who got the decisive goal from Nic Dowd in a shootout.

item.title: Gustavsson makes 29 saves as the Wild race to an early lead and beat the Flames 4-1
item.description: Danila Yurov and Vinnie Hinostroza scored in the first period and the Minnesota Wild went on to beat the Calgary Flames 4-1.

item.title: Southern California women beat No. 8 Iowa, snapping Hawkeyes' eight-game winning streak
item.description: Kara Dunn scored 25 points as Southern California defeated No. 8 Iowa 81-69.

item.title: American defender Alex Freeman transfers to Spain's Villarreal from Orlando City of the MLS
item.description: Alex Freeman, a hopeful for this year's U.S. World Cup roster, has transferred to Spain's Villarreal from Major League Soccer's Orlando.

item.title: No. 3 South Carolina tops Auburn 81-51 behind another strong effort from Joyce Edwards
item.description: Joyce Edwards scored 20 points, Tessa Johnson added 13 and No. 3 South Carolina handled Auburn 81-51.

item.title: Snuggerud scores late power-play goal, Blues beat Panthers to end 5-game skid
item.description: Jimmy Snuggerud scored on a power play with 7.6 seconds left to give the St. Louis Blues a 5-4 victory over Florida on Thursday night, spoiling Matthew Tkachuk's best game in his return from adductor muscle surgery.

item.title: Powell scores 21 points and Heat outlast Bulls for 116-113 win
item.description: Norman Powell scores 21 points as the Miami Heat secure a 116-113 win over the Chicago Bulls.

item.title: Murray scores 27, Nuggets beat Nets 107-103 in Porter's return to Denver
item.description: Jamal Murray scored nine of his 27 points in the final 2:26, and the Nuggets spoiled Michael Porter Jr.'s return to Denver with a 107-103 win over the Brooklyn Nets.

item.title: Dillon Brooks scores career-high 40 on his own T-shirt night, leading Suns past Pistons 114-96
item.description: Dillon Brooks scored a career-high 40 points, Grayson Allen added 24 and the Phoenix Suns beat the Eastern Conference-leading Detroit Pistons 114-96 on Thursday night.

item.title: Hornets edge Mavericks 123-121 to spoil Cooper Flagg' 49-point game
item.description: Kon Knueppel made two free throws with 4.1 seconds left for a career-high 34 points and the Charlotte Hornets beat the Dallas Mavericks 123-121 on Thursday night, spoiling Duke roommate Cooper Flagg's 49-point game.
